Home.featuresTitle: Everything a new app needs, nothing it doesn't
Home.featuresIntro: Replace this page with your own story. The parts below are already working.

i18n.title: Speaks every language you pick
i18n.body: Localized pages, emails and legal text, with hreflang and a language switcher.

seo.title: Found by search and AI
seo.body: Sitemap, canonical URLs, structured data, share cards, llms.txt and a Markdown copy of every page.

auth.title: Secure sign-in
auth.body: Email and password, Google and GitHub, passkeys and two-factor authentication.

api.title: One API, three doors
api.body: Each operation serves the app, a documented REST API and an MCP server for AI clients.

agents.title: Built for coding agents
agents.body: AGENTS.md, a setup runbook and skills teach agents how to extend the app safely.

open.title: Free and open tools
open.body: No paid service is required. Each one is optional and has a free fallback.
